projects.name: RAYYAN-NET Portfolio Interface
projects.description: Modular, event-driven portfolio interface built from scratch. Features an Entity-inspired boot sequence, animated neural network background, JSON-driven overlay system, interactive node graph, and a hidden DevTools console with real commands. Zero dependencies, zero frameworks.
projects.highlight: The architecture itself is the portfolio — modular JS, clean separation of concerns, event-driven design.

projects.name: CTF Writeups & Practice Labs
projects.description: Ongoing documentation of CTF challenges and HackTheBox / TryHackMe rooms. Each writeup captures methodology, dead ends, tools used, and lessons learned — demonstrating structured thinking and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly.
projects.highlight: Focus on methodology over solutions — showing how problems are approached, not just solved.

projects.name: IT Automation Scripts
projects.description: Collection of automation tools built during support work and lab environments. Includes user account management scripts, log parsing utilities, and system health check tools designed to reduce repetitive tier 1 workload.
projects.highlight: Built to solve real problems encountered in live support environments.

projects.name: Academic Security Labs
projects.description: Structured lab work completed during the Diploma in Systems Management & Cybersecurity at Oulton College. Covers network segmentation, firewall configuration, packet analysis, vulnerability scanning, and incident response procedures.
projects.highlight: Graduated with Honors · GPA 3.9 — labs backed by graded assessments and documented reports.
